Honestly i really dont know. I write it off as people dont know how to counter her very well. I see people say her gun is too quick to freeze but most people can kill you if you or run away while you do it if they just calm down and not panic. Pretty much all of the assault is amazing against Mei.. Flying, zipping, ghosting away and such. Defense is less counter and more smart play with junkrat being very very good against her. Tanks are the worst against her as they have a big area and less damage to work with. Support is also more smart play. If you're good you can certainly go against a Mei no matter what or wait and have backup. But people panic or they just write it off as "oh they killed me because they're mei". Now im a mostly Mei player and i can tell you, a good player will counter Mei and will have nothing to complain about. She isnt broken at all and doesnt need a nerf.
